# Management APIs

Manage applications, users, cluster nodes, server settings, and system status (Web Panel API).

Part of the [API Catalog](./). Full schemas: [Management Swagger](https://antmedia.io/rest/?urls.primaryName=3.0.3-management). Auth walkthrough: [Web Panel API](/guides/developer-sdk-and-api/rest-api-guide/management-rest-apis/).

## Conventions

| Placeholder | Meaning |
|-------------|---------|
| `{domain}` | Server hostname or IP |
| `{app}` | Application name (often `live`) |
| Path/query placeholders | Match the parameter name in the tables below |

Use port `5080` with `http://` for local HTTP tests.

**Base URL:** `https://{domain}:5443/rest/v2/...` (no application name)

**Auth:** `-H "ProxyAuthorization: {JWTToken}"` (server JWT) or dashboard username/password — see [Web Panel API](/guides/developer-sdk-and-api/rest-api-guide/management-rest-apis/).

:::tip Windows Command Prompt
Escape JSON quotes in `-d` bodies: `-d "{""name"":""My Stream""}"`
:::

## Applications

### `getApplications`

[Gets the applications in the server](https://antmedia.io/rest/?urls.primaryName=3.0.3-management#/default/getApplications)

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `GET` | `/rest/v2/applications` |

```bash
curl -X GET \
  -H "ProxyAuthorization: {JWTToken}" \
  "https://{domain}:5443/rest/v2/applications"
```

### `deleteApplication`

[Deletes application with the given name](https://antmedia.io/rest/?urls.primaryName=3.0.3-management#/default/deleteApplication)

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `DELETE` | `/rest/v2/applications/{appName}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `appName` | path | yes | Name of the application to delete |
| `deleteDB` | query | yes | Whether to delete associated database |

```bash
curl -X DELETE \
  -H "ProxyAuthorization: {JWTToken}" \
  "https://{domain}:5443/rest/v2/applications/{appName}?deleteDB={deleteDB}"
```

### `createApplication`

[Creates a new application with given name](https://antmedia.io/rest/?urls.primaryName=3.0.3-management#/default/createApplication)

| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| `POST` | `/rest/v2/applications/{appName}` |

| Parameter | In | Required | Description |
|-----------|----|----------|-------------|
| `appName` | path | yes | Name for the new application |

```bash

  -H "ProxyAuthorization: {JWTToken}" \
  "https://{domain}:5443/rest/v2/applications/{appName}"
```

[Creates a new application with given name and supports uploading custom WAR files](https://antmedia.io/rest/?urls.primaryName=3.0.3-management#/default/createApplication_1)

|--------|------|
